title: Control visible limits carefully
summary: Axis limits choose the part of the number range shown. Use them deliberately and tell readers when a narrow range matters.
introduction: Axis limits choose the part of the number range shown. Use them deliberately and tell readers when a narrow range matters. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Axis limits choose the part of the number range shown. Use them deliberately and tell readers when a narrow range matters.

blocks.code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot([1, 2, 3], [8, 9, 10])
ax.set_ylim(0, 12)
plt.show()
blocks.title: Control visible limits carefully

blocks.text: The y-axis displays zero through 12, keeping the small differences in context.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Compare with limits 7 to 11 and describe how the impression changes.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A zoomed axis can make a small difference look huge.
For more detail later, use this [Matplotlib further reading](https://matplotlib.org/stable/users/explain/quick_start.html).
